narrative.intro: Kiewit Infrastructure South reported $387M in federal contract obligations in FY2026 to date. Kiewit Infrastructure South received 3 awards so far, and the average award size is $129M. Kiewit Infrastructure South’s obligations are concentrated in Highway, Street, and Bridge Construction at $297M and in Power and Communication Line and Related Structures Construction at $90.3M. Kiewit Infrastructure South’s top buying agencies are the Department of Agriculture at $261M, the National Aeronautics and Space Administration at $90.3M, and the Department of Defense at $36M. The FY2026 totals are fiscal year to date and represent contract obligations except where award-value figures are total contract values. The reported activity shows a small number of large awards driving the year-to-date obligations and a clear split between transportation infrastructure and power/communications construction work.

sections.heading: Who are the top buying agencies for Kiewit Infrastructure South?
sections.body: The Department of Agriculture is the largest buyer, obligating $261M to Kiewit Infrastructure South. The National Aeronautics and Space Administration follows with $90.3M. The Department of Defense obligated $36M. Those three agencies represent the reported FY2026 to date obligations.

sections.heading: What markets does Kiewit Infrastructure South serve in federal work?
sections.body: Highway, Street, and Bridge Construction is the largest market at $297M. Power and Communication Line and Related Structures Construction is the second market at $90.3M. The FY2026 obligations align with those two NAICS markets.

faq.a: Kiewit Infrastructure South has $387M in federal contract obligations in FY2026 to date. Kiewit Infrastructure South received 3 awards in FY2026 to date and the average award size is $129M.

faq.q: Which agencies buy from Kiewit Infrastructure South?
faq.a: The Department of Agriculture, the National Aeronautics and Space Administration, and the Department of Defense buy from Kiewit Infrastructure South. The Department of Agriculture obligated $261M, NASA obligated $90.3M, and the Department of Defense obligated $36M.

faq.q: What does Kiewit Infrastructure South sell to the government?
faq.a: Kiewit Infrastructure South sells highway, street, and bridge construction and power and communication line and related structures construction to the government. Highway, Street, and Bridge Construction received $297M, and Power and Communication Line and Related Structures Construction received $90.3M.
